novel_features.name: Selected-pitch requirement check
novel_features.description: Check one specific pitch for vehicle, group, pet and power requirements without certifying unreported dimensions.
novel_features.rationale: Combines campsite category with the selected plan and user requirements.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this for explicit contradictions and unknowns on a chosen pitch.

novel_features.name: Evidence shortlist comparison
novel_features.description: Compare a bounded shortlist of specific campsite/pitch pairs with the same requirements.
novel_features.rationale: Applies consistent cross-entity evidence checks to each selected pitch.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when comparing selected pitches across an itinerary.

novel_features.name: Consecutive acceptance windows
novel_features.description: Find candidate consecutive nights from dated source acceptance evidence.
novel_features.rationale: Computes requested stay windows from the source status legend.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this for multi-night planning with explicit unknown inventory.

novel_features.name: Dated evidence snapshot
novel_features.description: Capture a compact dated observation spanning campsite, pitch and optional calendar.
novel_features.rationale: Preserves related source facts and coverage for later comparison.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this to save a reviewable itinerary observation.

novel_features.name: Observation drift comparison
novel_features.description: Compare two saved observations of the same campsite and pitch.
novel_features.rationale: Computes local fact changes while separating different date coverage.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this to detect source changes without repeating HTTP requests.

narrative.headline: Plan campervan campsite stays with source-backed pitch rules and dated acceptance evidence.
narrative.value_prop: Discover public campervan-entry campsites, inspect the specific pitch and compare a bounded shortlist. Planner commands distinguish source acceptance and starting prices from unknown vehicle clearance, vacancy and full totals.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public read-only source contracts need no API key or account. Booking is a canonical-site handoff.
narrative.when_to_use: Use for public Nap Camp campsite and specific pitch planning, campervan-entry discovery, conservative requirements checks, dated source acceptance, and local observation comparisons. Keep Japanese names and URLs in the itinerary.
anti_triggers: Bookings, payments, account actions or guaranteed inventory.
Vehicle clearance certification, driving routes or complete dated group/option quotes.

recipes.title: Compare specific pitches
recipes.explanation: Each pair is checked independently; facility categories are not pitch permission.

recipes.title: Consecutive candidate nights
recipes.explanation: Only nights with source acceptance statuses 1/2 form candidates; vacancy is unknown.

recipes.title: Narrow pitch facts
recipes.explanation: Return only the selected source facts; those fields do not establish vehicle dimensions or a full dated total.

recipes.title: Read a dated source calendar
recipes.explanation: Filter the two-month upstream response to the requested month; zero nonacceptance prices stay unknown.
